text: Implemented the internal-experimental reframe4s-flashalign JVM/JS cross-project with the nine approved dependency edges and no umbrella, HalfFlow, motion, field, or flow dependency. The public surface uses canonical Sampled D3 Rank 3 scalar images, typed presets, validated immutable config, model-specific rigid and affine plans/results, exact existing registration result composition, reusable plan-owned workspace state, and closed errors. An unfinished engine returns EngineUnavailable rather than identity success. Evidence: PRD/build graph passes at 27 nodes and 94 edges; symbol ownership passes at 1074 public names and 59 canonical owners; shared API has no filesystem, NIfTI, motion, or HalfFlow references; JVM and Scala.js both pass FlashalignApiSuite 5 of 5, including compile-negative frame/rank/label/result probes and workspace reuse/conflict behavior.
